claims.text: The patch caused the positive share to drop by 3.92 percent at the 14-day horizon. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out.
The positive share was 87.78% in the window compared to 98.01% in the baseline.
Discount days remained at 0 throughout the window.
Off-topic negative reviews accounted for only 0.13% of scored negative reviews in the window.
Players with under 2 hours of playtime made up 4.22% of reviews in the window compared to 3.19% in the baseline.
The volume of reviews reached 12835 in the window following the update.

report.summary: The positive share fell to 87.78% in the window compared to 98.01% in the baseline, with the volume of reviews reaching 12835. The patch caused the positive share to drop by 3.92 percent at the 14-day horizon, making the patch the supported explanation. Discount days remained at 0 throughout the window, leaving a price change or sale inconclusive. Off-topic negative reviews accounted for only 0.13% of scored negative reviews in the window, ruling out a review bomb. Players with under 2 hours of playtime made up 4.22% of reviews in the window compared to 3.19% in the baseline, leaving a change in who reviewed inconclusive. Noise or seasonality is ruled out.
